name: Exp_SpearmanRankCorrelation_Histogram
summary: This EA uses the Spearman Rank Correlation indicator displayed as a histogram to identify statistically significant correlation shifts between price series and rank-ordered data. It generates trade signals when the correlation histogram crosses predefined threshold levels, entering positions on mean-reversion logic when correlation diverges from normal ranges. The strategy aims to capitalize on temporary statistical anomalies that tend to revert to their mean correlation value.
summary_zh: 该EA使用斯皮尔曼等级相关系数直方图指标来识别价格序列与排序数据之间统计显著的相关性变化。当相关性直方图穿越预定义阈值水平时产生交易信号，基于均值回归逻辑在相关性偏离正常范围时进场。该策略旨在利用倾向于回归均值相关性水平的临时统计异常。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于斯皮尔曼等级相关系数（Spearman Rank Correlation）构建交易策略，这是一种非参数统计指标，衡量两个变量之间的单调关系强度。入场条件为当相关性直方图值穿越预设的上下阈值时开仓——向上穿越上阈值时做多，向下穿越下阈值时做空，这体现了均值回归的核心思想：当相关性偏离正常水平时预期将回归。出场条件依赖反向信号或固定止损/止盈，当相关性从极端值回归时平仓获利。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，仅依赖用户手动设置合理的交易量。整体策略概念具有统计学基础，但缺少对市场结构变化和相关性崩塌的防护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA builds its trading strategy on the Spearman Rank Correlation coefficient, a non-parametric statistical indicator measuring the strength of monotonic relationships between two variables. Entry conditions trigger when the correlation histogram value crosses predefined upper or lower thresholds — going long when crossing above the upper threshold and short when crossing below the lower threshold, embodying the mean-reversion core idea that correlation deviations from normal levels are expected to revert. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, closing positions profitably when correlation reverts from extreme values. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management lacks risk-proportion control, relying solely on the user manually setting reasonable trade volumes. The overall strategy concept has a statistical foundation but lacks protection against market structure changes and correlation breakdowns.

parameters.name: InpRankCorrelationPeriod
parameters.description: 斯皮尔曼等级相关系数计算周期

parameters.name: InpThresholdUp
parameters.description: 上阈值，相关性高于此值产生做多信号
parameters.description_en: Upper threshold, correlation above = long signal

parameters.name: InpThresholdDown
parameters.description: 下阈值，相关性低于此值产生做空信号
parameters.description_en: Lower threshold, correlation below = short signal

parameters.name: InpStopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: InpTakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: 基于统计学原理的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数，具有数学理论支撑，非参数方法对异常值更稳健
直方图形式直观展示相关性变化，便于可视化判断市场状态
均值回归逻辑在震荡市中有较好表现，能捕捉统计异常带来的交易机会
pros_en: Built on the statistically rigorous Spearman Rank Correlation with mathematical theory backing; the non-parametric method is more robust to outliers
Histogram format visually displays correlation changes, making it intuitive to assess market conditions
Mean-reversion logic performs well in ranging markets, capturing trading opportunities from statistical anomalies
cons: 均值回归策略在趋势市中会持续亏损，相关性崩塌时无法有效应对
缺少动态仓位管理和风险比例控制，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模和市场波动
止损止盈默认为0，若用户未手动设置则面临无限亏损风险
cons_en: Mean-reversion strategy sustains continuous losses in trending markets; cannot effectively handle correlation breakdowns
Lacks dynamic position sizing and risk-proportion control; fixed lot size cannot adapt to different account sizes and market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, exposing the trader to unlimited loss risk if not manually configured
improvements: 增加自适应阈值机制，根据市场波动率动态调整相关性阈值，避免在趋势市中频繁错误入场
添加仓位管理模块，基于账户余额和ATR动态计算交易手数，并设置默认止损止盈值
improvements_en: Add adaptive threshold mechanism that dynamically adjusts correlation thresholds based on market volatility, preventing frequent false entries in trending markets
Add position sizing module that dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance and ATR, and set default stop-loss/take-profit values

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，若未设置则单笔亏损可能无限扩大
均值回归策略在强趋势行情中会连续逆势建仓造成累积亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit values are zero; without manual configuration, single-trade losses can expand indefinitely
Mean-reversion strategy builds consecutive counter-trend positions during strong trending markets, causing cumulative losses
